sections.content: You know *hay que* and *tener que* from A1 Unit 18, *deber* and *tener que* from B1 Unit 7, and impersonal *se* from B1 Unit 11. This lesson uses them for rules: *hay que* + infinitive says what everyone has to do, *deber* and *tener que* say who has to do it, and *no se permite*, *está prohibido* and *no se puede* say what is not allowed.

items.english: People have to follow the rules.

sections.content: *Hay que* is impersonal. *Tener que* and *deber* can name the person who has the obligation.
